papers.title_en: Thinker-WM: A Unified World Model with Shared Multimodal Representations for Embodied Intelligence
papers.authors: Thinker Team, Peng Gao, Jichao Jiao, Chen Liao, Daqin Luo, Yiming Ma, Baiyu Pan, Hailin Shi, Jiyuan Wang, Xiangming Xu, Xiongwei Zhao
papers.evidence: 面向具身预测与规划的统一多模态世界模型
papers.tldr: 现有具身世界模型在模态与功能上彼此割裂，视觉动态、几何结构与可执行动作多由独立接口或下游模块处理。Thinker-WM 以共享的 Unified Dynamics Transformer 为中间表征，将 RGB、度量深度与机器人动作联合编码并共同演化，同时保留各自的输出结构。同一套参数即支持视频-动作联合生成、世界预测、策略推断、动作条件生成与逆动力学等功能。模型在约 2 万小时自我中心视频、1 万小时真机与 1 千小时仿真数据上训练，并在 EWMBench、WorldOlympiad、WorldArena 上排名第一。
papers.abstract_en: World models have emerged as a promising paradigm for embodied AI, yet existing systems often remain fragmented in the modalities they model and the functions they support. In particular, visual dynamics, geometric structure, and executable action are commonly coupled through separate interfaces or downstream modules rather than being jointly represented and evolved within a shared dynamics model. In this work, we present Thinker-WM, a unified multimodal world model that jointly models and generates RGB, metric depth, and robot action through a shared intermediate Unified Dynamics Transformer with modality-specific encoders and decoders. The model performs multimodal unification at the representation level: appearance, geometry, and action are transformed into a common dynamic representation and jointly evolved by shared parameters, while their distinct output structures are preserved. The same parameterization supports multiple functions, including joint video-action generation, world prediction, policy inference, action-conditioned generation, video-to-action generation, and inverse dynamics. To examine whether the shared representation captures action-related information, we introduce a lightweight motion probe that shows the frozen visual representation contains recoverable motion information. Thinker-WM is trained on a heterogeneous corpus comprising approximately 20K hours of egocentric video, 10K hours of real-robot data, and 1K hours of simulation data, including approximately 4K hours of real-robot data with aligned depth supervision. Extensive experiments demonstrate strong performance across embodied world-model evaluations. Thinker-WM ranks first on EWMBench, WorldOlympiad and WorldArena, while controlled studies further demonstrate the benefits of action conditioning, geometric interaction, and multi-function training within the shared representation.

papers.title_en: Physical AI: A Survey of Models, Learning, Systems, and Open Challenges
papers.authors: Bin Gao, Anuj Gautam, Aritra Bagchi, Yunkai Liang, Wentao Li, Ronghui Li, Zhi Zhou, Yancan Mao, Xiao Yan, Xin He, Qingyun Zou, Wenshuo Yue, Dan Chen, Zhanglu Yan, Fei Xu, Huize Li, Weijie Wang, Tao Ouyang, Tulika Mitra
papers.evidence: 综述在物理世界中感知、推理与行动的物理智能体
papers.tldr: Physical AI 需在部分可观测、动态不确定与具身约束下实时感知决策，单纯模型提升难以支撑可靠自主。本文围绕物理交互闭环，系统梳理任务表示与记忆、预测与动作生成、数据学习、具身控制、计算系统、评估与安全。作者进一步分析各组件耦合如何塑造系统能力与局限，并归纳泛化、高效学习、状态跟踪、安全恢复与持续适应等挑战。文章主张从孤立模型性能转向集成系统，以实现稳健、高效、安全且自主的现实交互。
papers.abstract_en: Physical AI aims to enable intelligent systems to perceive, reason, act, and learn through interaction with the physical world. Unlike purely digital intelligence, physical agents must operate under partial observability, uncertain dynamics, embodiment constraints, and real-time requirements, while their actions continuously reshape the environment and subsequent observations. Recent advances in foundation models and robot learning have expanded the capabilities of physical agents, yet achieving reliable autonomy requires more than improvements in individual models. This survey presents a comprehensive, system-level review of Physical AI, organized around the closed-loop process of physical interaction. We examine the foundations and recent developments in task representations and memory, predictive and action-generating models, data and learning methods, embodiment and control, computing systems, evaluation, and safety. Beyond reviewing individual advances, we investigate how these components interact and collectively shape the capabilities and limitations of Physical AI systems. Building on this integrated perspective, we identify fundamental challenges in generalization, resource-efficient learning and execution, reliable state tracking, safety, recovery, and continual adaptation. We argue that advancing Physical AI requires moving beyond isolated model performance toward integrated systems capable of robust, efficient, safe, and autonomous physical interaction under changing real-world conditions.

papers.title_en: LAW: Unifying Language, Action, and World Modeling for Agentic Physical Intelligence
papers.authors: Jiajun Cao, Kai Tang, Bohua Zhang, Zezhong Qian, Ying Li, Xiaozhu Ju, Xiaobao Wei, Jiaming Liu, Yang Ding, Sixiang Chen, Yiding Sun, Siyuan Qian, Tinghao Wang, Jixian Wu, Yichen Guo, Yi Zhang, Shilong Zou, Yong Dai, Jian Tang, Shanghang Zhang
papers.evidence: 融合语言推理、动作生成与世界建模的世界-动作模型
papers.tldr: 长程机器人操作既需要预测动作和未来世界状态，也需要语言推理来规划子任务、判断执行进度并选择动作。LAW 是一个闭环的视觉语言模型与世界动作模型框架，用语义子任务进度把语言推理、动作生成和世界建模连接起来：混合专家视觉语言模型负责规划剩余子任务、评估并融合世界动作模型提出的动作，同时异步判断执行状态；世界动作模型则以混合 Transformer 专家联合建模视频与动作。在 RoboTwin 五十项任务上，LAW 平均成功率达到 94.21%，替换 OpenWAM-α 后升至 95.56%；在三个真实长程任务上平均成功率为 65%，明显优于 π0.5 和 Fast-WAM，显示出统一框架对物理智能体的价值。
papers.abstract_en: World-action models jointly predict actions and future world states, but long-horizon manipulation further requires language reasoning to plan subtask objectives, assess execution progress, and guide action selection. We present LAW, a closed-loop VLM--WAM framework that unifies language reasoning, action generation, and world modeling through semantic subtask progress. Within the LAW agent, a hybrid-expert vision-language model plans the remaining subtasks, estimates the values of and fuses actions proposed by a world-action model, and asynchronously assesses execution status to support continued execution and subtask transitions. Within the world-action model, Mixture-of-Transformer Experts integrates modality-specific and shared computation for joint video--action modeling. Dual-stream hierarchical visual memory maintains temporal context for both models, while subtask-local value learning aligns action evaluation with semantic objectives and preserves supervision from successful prefixes of failed trajectories. LAW achieves 94.21% average success across 50 RoboTwin tasks. Replacing the WAM backbone with OpenWAM-$alpha$ further raises the average success rate to 95.56%, establishing a new open-source state of the art on RoboTwin. Despite having only 2B parameters, our VLM also outperforms variants using Embodied-R1.5 and GPT-5.5 High. On three long-horizon real-robot tasks, LAW achieves 65% average success, compared with 28.33% for $pi_{0.5}$ and 25% for Fast-WAM.

papers.title_en: Watch, Recall, Act: Always-On Robots in Concurrent Embodied Streams
papers.authors: Ding Yi, Peiwen Sun, Chenchu Rong, Jianan Wang, Xili Dai, Xiangyu Yue, Xi Lin
papers.evidence: 面向常开机器人的流式具身策略，融合感知与历史动作
papers.tldr: 现有动作模型通常假定固定指令、无中途干预和单步推理，难以支撑机器人持续在线、双臂并发及长时程记忆。ARMS 以预训练 π0.5 为主干，接入轻量模块异步维护实时感知、本体状态与自身历史动作上下文，使观看和回忆不阻塞双臂同时行动。在双臂任务上，ARMS 达45%，明显高于最强基线28%，消融表明记忆模块、本体状态头和异步并发均必要。
papers.abstract_en: An always-on robot faces an endless stream that never resets: instructions arrive and lapse, the scene changes, and its own past actions reshape what it must reason about. Today's action models are built for the opposite: a fixed instruction, no mid-task intervention, single-step reasoning. In an open-ended world a robot must watch a live stream for far-future cues, recall its own far-past actions, and act on them under dual-arm concurrency. We present ARMS (Always-on Robot in Multi-modal Streams), a deliberately simple streaming policy: a single pretrained $π$0.5 backbone augmented by three lightweight modules that turn live perception, embodied states, and the robot's own past actions into context the backbone reads before it acts. The modules update this context asynchronously, so watching and recalling never block acting and the two arms act at once. Rather than inventing new mechanisms, ARMS integrates these learned context providers with an agent-causal self-history that logs which arm did what, and when. To supervise them without extra annotation, we build ARMS Dataset, whose staged construction script itself labels every module from real dual-arm teleoperation. Trained on it, ARMS reaches 45% on the combined task against 28% for the strongest of our four main baselines, and ablations confirm the memory module, the embodied-state head, and asynchronous concurrency are each necessary.

papers.title_en: From Passive Execution to Active Exploration: Agentic Embodied Manipulation in Realistic Environments
papers.authors: Shilin Ma, Chubin Zhang, Xulong Bai, Zifeng Gao, Shiyi Zhang, Yansong Tang
papers.evidence: 面向具身操作的智能体主动探索框架，包含规划、感知与执行模块
papers.tldr: 现有具身操作框架多采用被动执行范式，难以应对真实场景中的文本语义线索、干扰物与初始不可见目标。本文提出基于智能体的主动探索框架，由规划、感知、执行三个模块协同工作，并引入细粒度感知—执行交错策略，将视觉反馈与技能执行紧密耦合。在真实感Find-and-Place任务上验证了该方法需先主动发现目标再操作的有效性，推动机器人从被动执行走向主动探索。
papers.abstract_en: Recent advances in agentic systems have substantially enhanced the long-horizon capability of embodied manipulation. However, many existing frameworks still follow a passive execution paradigm, which limits their applicability to real-world scenarios involving textual semantic cues, distractors, and initially invisible targets. To bridge this gap, we propose an agent-based active exploration framework that enables robots to dynamically interact with the environment rather than merely execute predefined instructions. Specifically, our framework consists of three collaborative modules: a planning module for high-level task reasoning, a perception module for visual scene understanding, and an execution module for low-level manipulation. This design allows the robot to actively acquire task-relevant information, adapt its behavior based on environmental feedback, and complete manipulation tasks under partial observability. Furthermore, we introduce a fine-grained perception-execution interleaving strategy, which tightly couples visual feedback with skill execution to improve exploration robustness. We evaluate our method on a realistic Find-and-Place task, demonstrating its effectiveness in challenging environments where target objects must be actively discovered before manipulation.

papers.title_en: PORL: Pretrained Offline Reinforcement Learning for the Job Shop Scheduling Problem
papers.authors: Mateo Toro Diz, Jonathan Hoss, Noah Klarmann
papers.evidence: 面向作业车间调度问题的预训练离线强化学习方法
papers.tldr: 作业车间调度（JSSP）中，在线强化学习依赖仿真且存在虚实差距，离线强化学习又受数据质量制约。PORL先通过仿真在线预训练通用调度策略，再用KL散度约束进行离线微调以适配目标数据分布。在存在分布偏移及启发式、噪声专家、随机策略数据上，PORL的最优性差距低于纯离线RL和通用调度基线。该工作为难以在线探索的工业调度提供了预训练加离线适配的新思路。
papers.abstract_en: The Job Shop Scheduling Problem (JSSP) is a fundamental combinatorial optimization problem in industrial optimization. This work introduces Pretrained Offline Reinforcement Learning (PORL), a hybrid approach that combines simulation-based online pretraining with offline fine-tuning on production-specific data.   Reinforcement learning through online interaction enables exploration of general scheduling strategies, but typically relies on simulation environments and may suffer from a simulation-to-reality gap. In contrast, offline RL avoids direct interaction with the environment by learning from historical data, but its performance is strongly influenced by dataset quality and coverage. PORL combines the strengths of both paradigms by first learning a general scheduling policy through online interaction and subsequently adapting it offline to a target distribution. A KL-divergence-based policy constraint is introduced to limit deviations from the pretrained policy during fine-tuning.   The approach is evaluated on JSSP instances with distribution shift and datasets generated from heuristic, noisy-expert, and random behavioral policies. The results show that PORL consistently achieves lower optimality gaps than standalone offline RL and the considered general scheduling baselines. Furthermore, its advantage over standalone offline RL increases as dataset quality decreases, indicating reduced sensitivity to the quality and coverage of the available offline data. The results suggest that offline adaptation of pretrained policies is a promising approach for industrial scheduling environments where direct online exploration is impractical.

papers.title_en: Explore, Execute, Evolve: A Skill Acquisition and Reuse Loop for Embodied Agents
papers.authors: Sicheng Xie, Yitong Chen, Haidong Cao, Shunlin Lu, Zuxuan Wu, Yu-Gang Jiang
papers.evidence: 面向具身智能体的技能获取与复用闭环
papers.tldr: 通用多模态智能体在机器人零样本任务上有潜力，但常需从零推理与探索物理世界，执行成本高。RoboSkill 构建“探索—执行—演化”闭环，将技能获取与复用连接起来，并融合视觉与触觉反馈、用可复用代码增强文本引导。在 LIBERO-10 上，它将首回合成功率提升 12.5–25.0 个百分点，平均运行时间降低 7.6–72.4%；真实机器人成功率提升 8.3 个百分点，成功试验平均运行时间至少降低 14.4%。该工作为具身智能体降低探索与推理开销、提升泛化执行效率提供了可复用技能闭环方案。
papers.abstract_en: Vision-language-action and world-action models have demonstrated impressive capabilities in robotics, yet generalization to unseen tasks remains challenging. More recently, general-purpose multimodal agents have shown great potential for zero-shot robotic task solving. However, they often incur high execution costs by reasoning and exploring the physical world from scratch. To reduce these costs, we introduce RoboSkill, a framework that connects skill acquisition and reuse through an Explore, Execute, Evolve loop. Within this loop, the agent explores to gather task-relevant information, executes tasks while adapting to feedback, and evolves its skill library based on execution records. It then reuses these skills to guide exploration and execution in the next cycle, closing the loop. To improve loop efficiency, we complement vision with tactile feedback to reduce uncertainty during physical interaction. We further augment textual guidance with reusable code to reduce reasoning overhead during skill reuse. On LIBERO-10, RoboSkill improves first-episode success rates by 12.5--25.0 percentage points and reduces average runtime by 7.6--72.4% across four agents. On real robots, it improves success rates by 8.3 percentage points and reduces average runtime for successful trials by at least 14.4%.

papers.title_en: ASENA: Self-evolving Agents for Embodied Navigation
papers.authors: An-Chieh Cheng, Isabella Liu, Edmund Bu, Johan Bjorck, Hongxu Yin, Zhengyi Luo, Jan Kautz, Linxi "Jim" Fan, Yuke Zhu, Sifei Liu
papers.evidence: 将编码智能体与机器人感知执行相连的具身导航智能体系统
papers.tldr: 具身导航智能体常受限于预定义技能与静态策略。ASENA将通用编程智能体接入机器人感知、计算、监督执行与持久经验，使其能编写程序、检查结果、修复失败并复用可执行技能；同时提出4B单目导航策略ASENA-VLN作为可选工具。独立策略在R2R/RxR达68.7%/70.2%，接入编程智能体后两类基准成功率提升11个百分点并缩短执行时间。持续工作区演化还将重复任务成功率从72%提至98%、65%提至89%。
papers.abstract_en: We present ASENA, an embodied agent system that connects general-purpose coding agents to robot sensing, computation, supervised execution, and persistent experience. Agents can write and execute programs, inspect recorded outcomes, repair failures, and reuse notes and executable skills while keeping their model weights fixed. We further introduce ASENA-VLN, a 4B monocular navigation policy that serves as an optional tool within this programmable system. ASENA-VLN predicts body-frame trajectories for both extended routes and short-horizon behaviors using a shared vision-language decoder trained on route instructions, visual question answering, and a newly curated dataset of geometry-derived atomic navigation tasks. As a standalone policy, ASENA-VLN achieves state-of-the-art success rates of 68.7% on R2R and 70.2% on RxR. When integrated with a coding agent, learned navigation improves ASENA's success rate by 11 percentage points on both agentic benchmarks while reducing execution time. Through persistent workspace evolution and simulator feedback, ten passes over recurring 100-task subsets further improve success from 72% to 98% on R2R and from 65% to 89% on RxR. On embodied question answering, ASENA achieves state-of-the-art accuracy with fewer interaction steps. Finally, real-world demonstrations on a Unitree G1 combine search, visual inspection, spatial reasoning, and synthesized gestures without a pre-built map, illustrating how online programming extends robot behavior beyond route following and predefined skills.

papers.title_en: ChronoGraph: Functional 4D Scene Graphs with Vision-Language Models for Interaction Understanding and Grounded Planning
papers.authors: Chenyangguang Zhang, Malgorzata Gwiazda, Guanlong Jiao, Yuanchen Ju, Federico Tombari, Koushil Sreenath, Marc Pollefeys, Sunghwan Hong
papers.evidence: 支持具身预测与接地规划的4D场景图
papers.tldr: 具身智能体需理解4D交互变化并据此规划动作，但观测与预期变化缺乏统一表示。ChronoGraph将可供性部件上的动作与语义、几何状态变化连成功能性4D场景图，并用同一形式表示已观测和预期转换。作者构建ChronoGraphBench，以两阶段训练ChronoGraphVLM：图链式思维监督微调和4D图强化学习。实验显示多尺度模型优于预训练基线，可零样本迁移到VLM4D，并支持真实移动操作。
papers.abstract_en: Embodied agents must determine where to act, anticipate the resulting scene changes, and interpret observed outcomes to guide subsequent actions. This requires connecting 4D interaction understanding, which explains how past actions changed the scene, with spatially grounded planning, which determines how and where to act toward a goal and anticipates the resulting scene changes. We introduce ChronoGraph, a functional 4D scene graph that links actions on affordance parts to semantic and geometric state changes. By representing observed and anticipated transitions in the same form, it provides a shared basis for understanding and planning. We construct ChronoGraphBench through an automatic data engine that converts human-interaction videos and simulated robot trajectories into graph-annotated questions for training and evaluating Vision-Language Models (VLMs) on both tasks. Using these annotations, we train ChronoGraphVLM by adapting pretrained VLMs in two stages. Graph-as-Chain-of-Thought supervised fine-tuning teaches the models to reconstruct observed transitions and predict future ones as graph traces before answering. Subsequent joint 4D graph reinforcement learning directly rewards graph properties and answer correctness. Experiments across model scales show improvements over the corresponding pretrained baselines and zero-shot transfer to VLM4D. Real-world demonstrations further show that graph-based planning and affordance grounding support mobile manipulation through existing robot skills without additional fine-tuning.

papers.title_en: Are Frontier VLM Agents Ready to Be Robot Generalists? An Empirical Study with the Embodied Agent Arena
papers.authors: Haojian Huang, Pukun Zhao, Zexi Li, Yehang Zhang, Yangkai Wei, Wenqian Li, Han Yang, Kaiwen Zhou, Ying-Cong Chen, Yinchuan Li
papers.evidence: 评测视觉语言具身智能体的感知、规划与操作能力
papers.tldr: 前沿VLM智能体能否成为机器人通才仍不明确。本文提出Embodied Agent Arena，用1000个案例、32个来源及GeoProbe，在几何、空间推理、可供性、任务规划与操作五类任务上评估七个VLM智能体，并以最小测试框架保留源观测与操作。结果显示Astra在精确估计和可用接触定位上有优势，但轨迹端点错误明显、家庭任务完成率低；更丰富观测与多轮复核的效果随模型和任务变化。总体看，当前VLM智能体尚未达到具身通才水平，常只能部分推进，难以在预算内完成全部目标。
papers.abstract_en: Frontier vision-language models (VLMs) increasingly estimate scenes, ground interactions, and generate executable actions. How far these native capabilities support embodied generalism across diverse tasks remains unclear. We introduce Embodied Agent Arena to assess seven VLM agents across Geometry, Spatial Reasoning, Affordance, Task Planning, and Manipulation. The arena contains 1,000 cases drawn from 32 established sources and GeoProbe, our new benchmark for geometric estimation on Blender renders and real-scene images. A minimal harness preserves source observations and operations while leaving perception, reasoning, and action selection to the model. Separate measures of metric precision, functional grounding, and native goal completion connect local competence to complete task outcomes. Astra's strengths in precise estimation and usable-contact localization coexist with endpoint errors in tracing and low household-task completion. Supplementary comparisons of richer observations and multi-round review show model- and task-dependent effects. Current VLM agents thus fall short of embodied generalism: they often make partial progress without satisfying all task goals within allotted time and interaction budgets.

papers.title_en: Token Communication-Assisted Collaborative Embodied Artificial Intelligence: Concepts, Framework, and Opportunities
papers.authors: Peng Yi, Ying-Chang Liang
papers.evidence: 协同具身智能体在动态物理环境中协同感知、推理与行动
papers.tldr: 协作具身智能需在动态环境中交换多模态观测、任务洞察与意图，但传统通信难以兼顾开销与语义。本文提出以Token同时作为紧凑语义载体和生成模型推理单元的Token通信（TokCom），并构建由任务自适应协议驱动的CEAI框架。协同物体运输案例表明，该方法显著降低源载荷比特消耗，同时保持任务效率并具备噪声信道鲁棒性。该工作为CEAI原生智能通信提供了系统框架与研究展望。
papers.abstract_en: Collaborative embodied artificial intelligence (CEAI) enables multiple physical agents to perceive, reason, and act cooperatively in dynamic environments. Effective communication is essential for CEAI, yet CEAI agents must exchange not only large multimodal observations but also task-relevant insights, intents, and interactive information over long horizons. This article investigates token communication (TokCom) as a native intelligence interface for CEAI, in which tokens serve jointly as compact semantic carriers for communication and fundamental inference units for generative foundation models (GFMs). We first discuss how TokCom supports insight sharing, intent alignment, and interactive control among embodied agents. We then propose a TokCom-assisted CEAI framework driven by a task-adaptive communication protocol. Comprising a compact codebook, syntax rules, and contextual examples, this protocol guides GFM-based transceivers to distill messages into compact tokens and reconstruct them after wireless transmission. A case study on collaborative object transport demonstrates that the proposed TokCom framework substantially reduces the source payload bit consumption while preserving task efficiency and showing robustness under noisy channels. Finally, we outline future research directions.

papers.title_en: RoboBridge: A Self-Evolving Embodied Agent Framework for Sim-to-Real Transfer
papers.authors: Chenxi Li, Zhangrui Zhao, Rui Li, Yuan Gao, Kehui Liu, Jiarui Li, Dong Wang, Tong Si, Minting Pan, Wanli Ouyang, Dongzhan Zhou
papers.evidence: 面向仿真到现实迁移的自进化具身智能体
papers.tldr: 针对仿真到现实迁移依赖视觉动力学校准、额外演示和策略再训练的问题，RoboBridge将迁移视为可执行任务技能的持续适应。它把任务知识表示为连接意图、观测、工具操作与结果验证的过程，并用交互反馈生成候选技能修订，经评估后保留或拒绝。框架将预训练VLA策略封装为可复用动作工具，结合推理时引导实现细粒度执行而无需重训底层策略。在LIBERO-PRO及物理任务上验证技能演化与迁移后适应，为跨环境持续程序性学习提供路径。
papers.abstract_en: A key challenge in bringing embodied intelligence into the real world is transferring capabilities from simulation to reality and enabling agents to continually adapt after deployment. End-to-end vision-language-action policies provide strong manipulation capabilities, but their transfer to physical environments typically relies on calibrating simulated visual and dynamical conditions, collecting additional target-domain demonstrations, and optimizing the policy through further training. Tool-using embodied agents offer flexible task orchestration, yet existing systems primarily emphasize task execution and experience reuse within a given environment, with limited support for transferring procedural knowledge and continuously adapting it across simulation and reality. We propose RoboBridge, a framework that treats sim-to-real transfer as the continued adaptation of executable task skills. The agent represents task knowledge as procedures connecting task intent, observations, tool operations, and outcome verification. Interaction feedback is used to generate candidate skill revisions, which are evaluated before being persisted or rejected. A pretrained vision-language-action policy is exposed as a reusable action tool and enhanced with inference-time guidance, enabling fine-grained execution without retraining the underlying policy. RoboBridge grounds transferable skills in task semantics and interaction interfaces shared across simulation and reality. This representation preserves reusable task structure while allowing environment-dependent operations to be selectively revised through real-world execution feedback. We evaluate the framework on LIBERO-PRO and corresponding physical tasks, studying both skill evolution and post-transfer adaptation. Our framework provides a route from one-shot policy deployment to continual procedural learning across environments.

papers.title_en: EmbodiedRSI: Active Continual Robot Learning Through Hypothesis-Guided Co-Evolution
papers.authors: Python Song, Zhixuan Liang, Kelsey Fu, Mengdi Wang, Junfeng Yang, Shilong Liu
papers.evidence: 从物理交互中持续学习的自进化智能体框架
papers.tldr: 机器人基础模型在物体位置或指令变化时性能易降，后训练又依赖昂贵遥操作数据，现有自演化框架实验选择效率低。EmbodiedRSI以快慢双系统维护代码-技能假设图，用信息价值实验选择区分假设，驱动代码-技能共演化与奖励接地记忆学习。RoboCasa365总体成功率77.0%、Composite-Unseen 71.3%，最佳基线40.1%；LIBERO-Pro 86.8%，真实机器人零样本迁移71.3%。该工作将物理交互高效转化为代码与技能改进，推动主动持续机器人学习。
papers.abstract_en: Robot foundation models provide strong visuomotor control, yet their performance can degrade when object positions or task instructions change. Further improvements often require post-training on substantial robot data, which can be costly to collect through methods such as teleoperation. Agentic harnesses can adapt around the model, but current self-evolving harnesses use robot trials inefficiently when deciding which code and skill changes to pursue. We introduce EmbodiedRSI, a self-evolving agentic harness that autonomously decides where to explore next and turns the resulting physical interaction into improved code and skills. EmbodiedRSI realizes this through a Fast-Slow Dual-System Architecture, in which competing code and skill hypotheses are maintained in a Hypothesis Graph. Value-of-Information Experiment Selection chooses physical experiments that can distinguish these hypotheses. Their outcomes guide Code-Skill Co-Evolution. The Slow System builds Hierarchical Memory, and Reward-Grounded Memory Learning selects effective memory according to their value for later Fast-System improvement. On RoboCasa365, EmbodiedRSI reaches 77.0% overall success and 71.3% on Composite-Unseen, compared with 40.1% for the best baseline. EmbodiedRSI also reaches 86.8% overall success on LIBERO-Pro. Beyond benchmark performance, EmbodiedRSI transfers zero-shot to real-world robot, achieving 71.3% overall success across multiple challenging tasks.

papers.title_en: RoboAware: Learning to Coordinate Embodied Skills from Counterfactual Outcomes
papers.authors: Bohan Zhou, Xingbei Chen, Emily Huang, Weilin Ruan, Haojian Huang, Yehang Zhang, Zexi Li, Wenqian Li, Qize Yu, Zetian Song, Leyi Wu, Jinghao Li, Mingxuan Song, Xinrun Xu, Zongyang Qiu, Yangkai Wei, Tianyi Zhang, Kaiwen Zhou, Yinchuan Li, James Cheng
papers.evidence: 从反事实结果学习具身机器人技能的状态条件协调
papers.tldr: 具身编码智能体虽能组合模块化机器人技能与冻结的端到端策略，但需预判在当前物理状态下哪个策略族会成功。RoboAware 仅学习一个以状态为条件的责任协调器：先以 P⁵ 模式把技能统一到五个语义阶段，再用状态锁定反事实分支（SCB）在同一训练状态下执行各候选策略族的代码块，补全被选中分支所遗漏的结果。配合执行感知学习（EAL）将这些结果蒸馏为策略族条件价值。在 100 个任务上总体成功率达 77.0%，RoboSuite 90.0%、LIBERO-Pro 73.8%、RoboTwin 双臂任务 90.0%，超过现有 code-as-policy 与 VLA-harness 基线。
papers.abstract_en: Embodied coding agents can combine modular robot skills with frozen end-to-end policies, yet effective composition requires anticipating which policy family will succeed in the current physical state. We present RoboAware, which builds on coding agents' skill orchestration by learning only a state-conditioned responsibility coordinator from counterfactual outcomes. Inspired by the success of REPL, we propose the $P^5$ schema and formulate a hierarchical MDP based on it. $P^5$ organizes skills uniformly into five semantic stages, defining where responsibility can be compared. To address the lack of counterfactual branch outcomes in existing work, we introduce State-Locked Counterfactual Branching (SCB), which restores the same training state to generate and execute a code block from each admissible family, exposing outcomes that selected-branch experience leaves unobserved. Building on this, we propose Execution-Aware Learning (EAL), which combines Monte Carlo tree search with Q-learning to distill these outcomes into family-conditioned values. At deployment, the coordinator selects the policy family according to observable context, and the frozen coding agent generates the next local code block. Comprehensive single-episode evaluations on 100 tasks show that RoboAware reaches a 77.0% overall success rate, with SOTA averages of 90.0% on RoboSuite, 73.8% on diverse LIBERO-Pro task clusters, and 90.0% on challenging RoboTwin bimanual tasks, outperforming existing code-as-policy and VLA-harness baselines.

papers.title_en: A QPTAS for Stochastic Scheduling of Bernoulli Jobs
papers.authors: Junho Hwang
papers.evidence: 同构机上随机作业调度的拟多项式近似方案
papers.tldr: 研究 Bernoulli 随机加工时间作业在同构并行机上的调度，目标是最小化期望完工时间和，并以自适应策略为基准。作者提出按机器空闲时刻而非作业开始时刻做与作业规模成比例的网格舍入，从而构造拟多项式时间近似方案。该方案对任意机器数均成立，突破了此前仅常数种规模可近似、一般情形仅 O(log N) 近似的限制。论文还证明预先固定作业顺序会损失 Ω(log N) 因子，说明自适应顺序对常数近似必不可少。
papers.abstract_en: We study the classical problem of scheduling jobs with random processing times on $m$ identical machines to minimize the expected sum of completion times, for Bernoulli jobs: job $j$ takes time $p_j$ with probability $q_j$ and time $0$ otherwise, and its outcome is revealed when it starts. The benchmark is an optimal adaptive policy. We give a quasi-polynomial-time approximation scheme for every number of machines. Previously, quasi-polynomial time was known to give an $O(\log N)$-approximation, and approximation schemes were known only for a constant number of distinct sizes. The scheme rests on a simple observation: it suffices to round the times at which machines become free, rather than the times at which jobs start, to a grid whose width is proportional to the job size, and an optimal policy stretched by a factor close to one already respects such grids. We also show that every policy that fixes the order of the jobs in advance loses a factor $Ω(\log N)$, already on two machines, so a constant factor requires adapting the order to the observed outcomes. Further results include a polynomial-time adaptive rule with ratio $\min\{m,1+\sum_j q_j\}$, a simpler approximation scheme for a constant number of sizes, and #P-hardness of computing the optimal expected cost on two machines.

papers.title_en: LIVIN: Benchmarking Spatial and Embodied Intelligence in Digital Twins of Lived-In Homes
papers.authors: Peijun Xu, Chuansen Nie, Yiyang He, Yinuo Bai, Jingyang Liu, Kuixiang Shao, Yuyang Jiao, Kuanhao Xia, Jiayi Zhu, Zitian Yang, Yanqi Zhang, Tianye Tan, Shuwei Di, Junyi Xu, Jingyi Yu, Jiayuan Gu
papers.evidence: 基于真实居住家庭数字孪生、面向机器人交互的空间与具身智能基准
papers.tldr: 现有家庭模拟资源难以兼顾规模、真实对应与交互准备度，缺少忠实反映真实居住布置的可交互数字孪生。LIVIN基于30个多样真实家庭的数字孪生构建空间与具身智能基准，通过人机回环流程重建房间布局、家具配置和日常物品。基准评测3D检测、3D重建、导航与移动操作四类任务，显示现有方法受密集物体、遮挡、有限自由空间和受限交互区域制约。该工作为真实家庭中的具身AI提供可复现评测平台。
papers.abstract_en: Realistic household simulation must capture not only diverse environments but also the lived-in object arrangements and spatial constraints that shape robot motion and interaction. Existing resources often trade off scale, real-world correspondence, and interaction readiness, leaving a gap in faithful, interactive replicas of how real homes are actually arranged. To this end, we introduce LIVIN, a benchmark for spatial and embodied intelligence built on digital twins of 30 diverse lived-in homes. These replicas preserve observed room layouts, furniture configurations, and everyday belongings. To construct them, we design a human-in-the-loop workflow comprising instance recognition, architectural reconstruction, and object generation and placement, with intermediate results reviewed and corrected by humans against the source observations at each stage. We evaluate four tasks in LIVIN: 3D detection, 3D reconstruction, navigation, and loco-manipulation. Our evaluations show that current methods remain challenged by the dense object arrangements, occlusions, limited free space, and constrained interaction regions found in realistic lived-in homes. We hope LIVIN will help advance embodied AI in real-world homes, from spatial understanding to robotic interaction, and ultimately bring embodied intelligence into everyday home environments.

papers.title_en: EmbodiedCLBench: Evaluating Continual Learning for Self-Evolving Embodied Agents
papers.authors: Jie Huang, Yanan Chen, Ruixun Liu, Kaichen He, Xinyi He, Rui Huang, Zilong Zheng, Zhenliang Zhang, Yiwu Zhong
papers.evidence: 面向自进化具身智能体持续学习的基准
papers.tldr: 现有持续学习研究多局限于非具身场景，缺少对自演化具身智能体积累经验并迁移能力的系统评估。本文提出 EmbodiedCLBench，首个具身仿真持续学习基准，以组合泛化为核心，让智能体先学基础任务再重组技能解决未见复杂任务。实验显示零样本难以完成高级任务，但基础任务经验能稳定提升表现，且提升不随学习样本数增长。该基准揭示持续学习是具身智能体基础但尚未充分探索的能力。
papers.abstract_en: Continual learning requires models to accumulate past experience and transfer it to new tasks. Despite substantial research on continual learning, existing work remains largely confined to non-embodied settings, without extending to embodied environments. To address this gap, we introduce EmbodiedCLBench, the first benchmark in embodied simulation for evaluating the continual learning capability of self-evolving agents. With compositional generalization as the core evaluation principle, our benchmark evaluates whether agents can first learn from basic tasks and then recombine the acquired skills to solve complex, unseen advanced tasks. Based on EmbodiedCLBench, we conduct extensive experiments across multiple agent harnesses and learning methods, revealing consistent limitations and distinctive behaviors. Our results show that while advanced tasks can be hardly solved under zero-shot setting, the experience from basic tasks enables consistent improvement. Such benefit from the experience remains stable even if the task complexity increases. However, this improvement does not scale accordingly with the number of learning samples, and current agents cannot extract meaningful information from additional experience. Collectively, our findings highlight continual learning as a fundamental yet underexplored capability, and our benchmark offers valuable resources for designing effective self-evolving agents in embodied environments. Our code and dataset are available at https://pku-value-lab.github.io/EmbodiedCLBench-homepage.

papers.title_en: Learning to See through Action: Predictive Curiosity for Robots
papers.authors: Stelios Zarifis, Panagiotis Filntisis, George Retsinas, Petros Maragos
papers.evidence: 预测下一视觉潜状态的循环世界模型用于机器人主动学习
papers.tldr: 机器人能否通过主动交互而非固定数据学习视觉？作者提出DySCOVER自监督框架：用RGB帧训练视觉自编码器，并用循环世界模型预测动作后的下一视觉隐状态。策略仅由重建误差和预测误差构成的内在奖励驱动，鼓励新颖观测与不可预测轨迹。机械臂实验表明，加入预测好奇心比仅用视觉好奇心更稳定提升视觉学习，并在初始条件、经验容量、具身形态与场景内容变化下保持一致。
papers.abstract_en: Humans and animals do not learn vision from a fixed set of data: they move, interact, and learn from the visual consequences of their actions. Motivated by this developmental view, we study whether robots can improve visual learning by actively collecting experience through curiosity-driven interaction. We introduce DySCOVER, a self-supervised framework for active robot visual learning. A robot observes RGB frames, learns a visual autoencoder that encodes and reconstructs them, and trains a recurrent world model to predict the next visual latent state conditioned on the current state and action. The agent's policy is trained only with intrinsic rewards: reconstruction error encourages visually novel observations, while the world model's error encourages transitions whose consequences are not yet predictable. This prediction error biases the policy toward more intricate trajectories that enrich the agent's set of experiences with observations beyond those encouraged by visual novelty alone. Our experiments conducted with robotic arms as the embodied agents show that adding predictive curiosity improves the vision model over using visual curiosity alone. Across variations in initial conditions, experience capacity, embodiment, and scene content, adding predictive curiosity consistently improved visual learning. These results show that predictive curiosity can improve active visual learning beyond reconstruction-based curiosity alone.

papers.title_en: Solving Distributed Flexible Job Shop Scheduling Problem Using SAT
papers.authors: Phuong Dang Anh, Duc Nguyen Kim Trung, To Van Khanh
papers.evidence: 基于SAT精确求解分布式柔性作业车间调度
papers.tldr: 分布式柔性作业车间调度需同时决定工厂分配、机器选择与工序排序以最小化完工时间。本文提出基于SAT的精确求解框架，利用传播、对称性破除与增量SAT求解挖掘问题结构。在76个标准算例的两/三工厂配置上，该方法将已证最优实例增至72个，并在两个实例上刷新已知最优完工时间。SAT在五个配置中的四个取得最佳结果，为DFJSP提供兼具解质量与最优性证书的补充精确方法。
papers.abstract_en: The Distributed Flexible Job Shop Scheduling Problem (DFJSP) requires the joint determination of factory assignment, machine selection, and operation sequencing to minimize the makespan. This paper presents an exact SAT-based approach built on an efficient SAT formulation that exploits problem structure through propagation, symmetry breaking, and incremental SAT solving to effectively address these coupled decisions. The proposed method is evaluated on 76 standard benchmark instances from the Fattahi, Brandimarte, and rdata datasets under two- and three-factory configurations. Together with previously established results, the new SAT optimality certificates bring the total number of proven-optimal instances to 72 out of 76, including three newly certified instances; for two of these instances, SAT also improves the previous best-known makespans. Across the benchmark configurations, SAT achieves the best results on four of the five configurations and remains competitive with strong exact approaches such as CP and LBBD1_CPIL, as well as existing metaheuristic methods. These results demonstrate that the proposed SAT framework is an effective exact approach for the DFJSP, combining strong solution quality with rigorous optimality certification and offering a complementary exact method for future DFJSP studies and evaluations on additional benchmark instances.

papers.title_en: Improved Approximations for Coflow Scheduling via Iterated Rounding and Stable Matchings
papers.authors: Mikhail Cherniavskii, Arseni Fedorovich, Mikhail Koshelev, Andrey Kupavskii, Stanislav Moiseev, Fedor Ozhegov, Alexander Shekhovtsov
papers.evidence: 改进的协同流调度近似算法
papers.tldr: Coflow Scheduling由Chowdhury等提出，是数据中心网络中需在数据流依赖与链路容量约束下优化完成时间的关键调度问题。论文提出新型迭代舍入方案，并与基于Gale–Shapley稳定匹配的Galvin列表边染色方法结合，构造确定性多项式时间算法。无释放日期时近似比达到2.77，整数释放日期时达到3.17。两项结果分别改进此前3.42和4.36的保证，为Coflow调度提供了更强的理论性能保障。
papers.abstract_en: We study Coflow Scheduling, introduced by Chowdhury, Zhong, and Stoica (2014). We give deterministic polynomial-time algorithms achieving a $2.77$-approximation without release dates and a $3.17$-approximation with integer release dates. These improve the $3.42$ and $4.36$ guarantees of Rohwedder and Schnaars (2025).   Our approach combines two ideas: (1) a novel iterated rounding scheme, and (2) Galvin's list edge coloring method, which is based on the Gale--Shapley stable matching algorithm.

papers.title_en: Towards a Systematic Study of Embodied System 2 over Full Task Execution Cycles
papers.authors: Yuxi Wei, Ye Fang, Shuai Yang, Tong Wu, Tai Wang, Xiaojuan Qi
papers.evidence: 具身系统2的观测驱动规划、执行与恢复
papers.tldr: 现有具身System 2评测多为开环或闭环证据有限，难以检验智能体根据自身决策获取观察并完成规划、执行与恢复的全周期能力。作者提出SCOPER，用持续视觉观察、共享规则System 1和可控执行失败构建870个任务及约3500个情境问题。基准显示智能体在保留场景证据、监控进度和异常恢复上存在明显困难。SCOPER-harness无需额外训练即提升任务成功率11.1%–28.6%，并让9B模型超过直接执行的27B模型。
papers.abstract_en: An embodied brain, or System 2, must turn an abstract goal into actions while discovering relevant scene conditions and checking whether executed skills achieved their intended effects. Open-loop evaluations cannot test observations shaped by an agent's decisions, while some closed-loop evaluations provide limited evidence during execution or assume idealized skill outcomes. We introduce SCOPER, a suite for studying observation-grounded planning, execution, and recovery. SCOPER-bench combines high-level goals, ongoing visual observations, a shared rule-based System 1 for low-level actions, and controlled execution failures. Its construction and validation pipeline yields 870 tasks across BEHAVIOR and ProcTHOR, complemented by about 3,500 situated questions tied to the evaluated agent's execution. Benchmark results reveal difficulties in retaining scene evidence, monitoring progress, and recovering from unexpected outcomes. To address these difficulties, SCOPER-harness combines Evidence Memory and Progress Verification with a dynamic task agenda and bounded exploration, without additional model training. Across two evaluated open-source backbones and two simulators, the harness improves task success by 11.1-28.6%; a harnessed 9B model outperforms a directly executed 27B model on both simulators. In an offline next-action evaluation using observations from 200 real-robot demonstrations, the harness also improves full-call accuracy by 14.7% and 15.3%. SCOPER provides a setting for diagnosing and improving embodied reasoning throughout a complete task execution cycle.

papers.title_en: ABot-ER: Unified Embodied Reasoning through Agentic Data-Model Co-Evolution
papers.authors: Qiuyu Ding, Heng-Da Xu, Changda Xia, Jiajun Shen, Zihao Guan, Zhengchen Yuan, Jianfang Zhang, Di Yang, Jiayi Tian, Yuting Xu, Fei Wang, Shiao Liu, Wei Zhang, Xiaolong Wu, Wenbin Tang, Zedong Chu, Mu Xu
papers.evidence: 覆盖感知、规划与执行的统一具身推理基础模型
papers.tldr: 具身智能需同时兼顾感知、规划与执行，但统一模型常面临广度与深度难以兼得的问题。ABot-ER 以统一具身推理基础模型为核心，结合智能体数据-模型自演化引擎，并用任务条件自适应训练在共享主干上激活低秩残差。它在十二个基准、三类能力与五个维度上取得感知、规划、执行的整体最优。该工作表明统一参数框架内可实现广度与深度的共存。
papers.abstract_en: We introduce ABot Embodied Reasoning (ABot-ER), a unified embodied reasoning foundation model that breaks the tension between breadth and depth in embodied reasoning. Embodied intelligence demands the joint mastery of perception, planning, and execution, yet reconciling generality with specialization across this spectrum remains an open challenge. Within a single unified model, ABot-ER commands specialist-level depth across all three competencies, spanning spatial, scene, and temporal reasoning in perception; long-horizon action organization in planning; and point grounding and affordance in execution. The Agentic Data-Model Self-Evolution Engine continuously adapts data strategies to the model's evolving capability state. The Task-Conditioned Adaptive Training Strategy uses task tokens to activate lightweight low-rank residuals over a shared backbone, separating updates from heterogeneous output formats while retaining shared embodied knowledge. Across a systematic evaluation on twelve benchmarks covering three core competencies and five capability dimensions, ABot-ER achieves state-of-the-art overall performance across perception, planning, and execution within a unified parametric framework, demonstrating that breadth and depth can coexist in unified embodied reasoning.

papers.title_en: Plan-Bench: Can Existing VLMs Go Well Beyond Perception to Reason and Plan in Embodied Worlds?
papers.authors: Juntong Feng, Qingan Liu, Jingru Dong, Yue Zhu, Weiming Zheng, Yujie Cheng, Xinzhe Han, Shuai Hao, Yunzhi Zhuge, Haiwen Diao, Huchuan Lu
papers.evidence: 评估视觉语言模型具身推理与多步规划的基准
papers.tldr: 现有视觉语言模型在感知与空间推理上表现突出，但其能否脱离动作执行、在具身环境中完成高层推理与多步规划仍不清楚。作者提出 Plan-Bench，从三个互补维度构建 16 个子类、699 个精选样本，系统评测模型的推理与规划能力。对 28 个 VLM 的测试显示，最强模型准确率仅 75.0%，模型规模扩大可带来提升。该基准为评估 VLM 作为具身任务高层规划器的潜力提供了轻量探针。
papers.abstract_en: Vision-Language Models (VLMs) have achieved strong performance in visual perception and spatial reasoning, leading to growing interest in using them as high-level planners for embodied AI. However, physical tasks require models to integrate spatial information, reason over temporal states, and generate multi-step plans under various constraints, raising the question of whether current VLMs can reliably support such reasoning and planning independently of execution. We introduce Plan-Bench, a benchmark for evaluating the high-level reasoning and multi-step planning capabilities of VLMs relevant to embodied worlds, while isolating the influence of action execution. It covers three complementary dimensions, spanning 16 subclasses and 699 curated samples. Extensive evaluation of 28 VLMs reveals room for improvement, with even the strongest model achieving only 75.0% accuracy. We further find that model scaling generally improves these capabilities. Ablation studies also indicate larger models show increasing potential as high-level planners. Overall, Plan-Bench provides a lightweight probe for evaluating VLMs' reasoning and planning capabilities relevant to embodied environments and assessing their potential as decision makers for physical tasks. Our benchmark and code are available at https://github.com/MinneFeng/Plan-Bench.

papers.title_en: EmbodiedEvo: Self-Evolving Coding Agent For Physical Intelligence
papers.authors: Wenyi Li, Yizhe Chi, Youjie Zheng, Chunyu Liu, Xiaoqiu Wang, Mingju Gao, Zheng Jiang, Deyao Hong, Calvin Xiao, Kaisen Yang, Qinhuai Na
papers.evidence: 通过程序化机器人接口充当闭环具身策略的自演化编码智能体
papers.tldr: 具身编码智能体能在单回合内借助程序反馈适应物理场景，但跨场景时新智能体无法复用已摸索出的操作及其前条件，反复消耗交互与推理预算。EmbodiedEvo 将物理反馈蒸馏为可复用的代码 Skills 和诊断 Lessons，先在单个 Playground 场景获取经验再冻结，供未见场景的独立智能体调用且不更新权重。在 RoboDojo-Sim 上取得平均分44.48、成功率37.82%，超过官方已验证结果；记忆依赖任务收益最大，强模型经验还能提升弱执行器，并将执行成本较原始交互历史降低53.0%。
papers.abstract_en: Coding agents can construct executable programs and revise them through feedback, offering a foundation for embodied control without target-task fine-tuning. Through a programmatic robot interface, the agent observes the scene, executes control programs, and adapts them to the resulting physical state, serving as the closed-loop policy. However, this within-episode adaptation does not automatically preserve experience across scenes. Our trajectory analysis shows that agents spend interaction and inference budgets establishing effective operations and identifying their preconditions, while fresh agents cannot reuse these discoveries. This motivates EmbodiedEvo, a self-evolving coding agent that distills physical feedback into reusable code Skills and diagnostic Lessons. Experience is acquired on one Playground scene per task, then frozen for independent agents in unseen scenes, without updating model weights. On RoboDojo-Sim, EmbodiedEvo achieves an average score of 44.48 and a success rate of 37.82\%, surpassing all officially verified results. Paired tests show the largest gains on memory-dependent tasks and successful reuse of coordinated procedures, while fine contact control remains difficult. Experience from stronger models also improves weaker executors: Astra's experience raises Sol and Luna's success rates by 8.86 and 5.50 percentage points over no experience. Compared with raw interaction history, Skills and Lessons achieve comparable task performance at 53.0\% lower execution cost.

papers.title_en: Reflect After Failure: Brain-Inspired Self-Evolving Agents for Embodied Spatial Intelligence
papers.authors: Xin Li, Xiaohuan Gu, Yifan Wang, Shaobin Ling, Tianli Shi, Jingao Xu, Zhimeng Yin, Dapeng Wu, Yun Wang
papers.evidence: 面向具身空间智能并具失败反思能力的自进化智能体
papers.tldr: 现有VLM自进化智能体在具身空间任务中难以从部分视觉证据判断失败源于感知、探索还是规划，单纯累积交互经验会强化无效策略。HiMeco受元认知监控与海马记忆巩固启发，通过海马-元认知反思诊断感知-探索-规划失败，比较执行尝试提炼可复用策略，并将交互程序抽象为带证据契约和验证的参量化技能。它在ESI-Bench取得SOTA，并在不进化条件下将EmbSpatial-Bench准确率提升3.94个百分点，为失败驱动的具身空间自进化提供了新范式。
papers.abstract_en: Vision-Language Models (VLMs) have made substantial progress in spatial reasoning, and self-evolving agents further extend these capabilities to embodied environments by learning from interactions. However, current self-evolution remains particularly challenging in embodied spatial tasks, complex and multi-step decisions from partial visual evidence making it difficult to determine why an execution fails. The failure may stem from misperception, insufficient exploration, or incorrect planning, yet execution feedback alone rarely reveals which component is responsible. As a result, simply accumulating interaction experience can reinforce ineffective strategies. To address this, we propose HiMeco, a brain-inspired self-evolving agent for embodied spatial intelligence, inspired by metacognitive monitoring and hippocampal memory consolidation. Through Hippocampal-Metacognitive Reflection, HiMeco diagnoses failures in perception-exploration-planning (PEP), then compares execution attempts to derive reusable strategies and guidance for avoiding recurring errors. It also abstracts interaction programs into parameterized skills, using evidence contracts and execution-based validation to determine their retention and reuse. These strategies and skills guide subsequent interactions, with memory updated only between rounds and model parameters kept frozen. HiMeco achieves state-of-the-art performance on ESI-Bench, and it also improves accuracy on EmbSpatial-Bench by 3.94 percentage points without evolution.

papers.title_en: Towards Agentic Robots: Model, Data, Environment, and Harness
papers.authors: Chonghan Qin, Dongming Wu, Kaituo Feng, Jiaxu Wang, Xinlei Yu, Peiwen Sun, Yijia Fan, Xilin He, Bingao Chen, Weitong Lian, Ryan Ji, Wenqi Ren, Xiaobin Hu, Dahua Lin, Yu-Gang Jiang, Xiangyu Yue
papers.evidence: 涵盖模型、数据、环境与执行的智能体机器人统一综述
papers.tldr: 机器人智能正从底层动作预测转向基础模型驱动的目标导向编排，但研究分散且缺乏统一系统视角。本文综述 agentic robots，梳理从机器人策略到 VLA、世界模型与世界-动作模型的发展，并厘清其定义与范围。作者以 Model、Data、Environment、Harness 四大功能域组织十七类研究，分析智能体如何塑造模型学习与决策、采集数据、构建世界任务与测试并组织能力。最后总结开放挑战与未来方向，为构建更可靠自适应的智能体机器人提供统一框架。
papers.abstract_en: Foundation models are driving a paradigm shift in robotic intelligence, moving beyond low-level action prediction to goal-directed orchestration of data collection, model training, task planning, and real-world execution. We characterize this emerging paradigm as an agentic robots, in which agents reason over human instructions, interact with robotic environments, rectify execution errors autonomously, and dynamically adjust operational strategies. Although this field develops fast, current studies are not well connected. Researchers have no consistent view of how to combine different agentic functions into a complete robot system. This paper provides a unified overview of existing research on agentic robots. We first trace the development from robot policies to agentic systems, covering vision-language-action models, world models, and world-action models. We then clarify the definition and scope of agentic robots and organize existing research into seventeen categories across four functional domains: Model, Data, Environment, and Harness. Across these domains, we examine how agents shape model learning and robot decisions, collect and curate robot data, construct worlds, tasks, and tests for learning and evaluation, and organize capabilities for robot use. Finally, we discuss open challenges and outline directions for future research. Looking forward, we hope this work contributes to a clearer understanding of agentic robots and supports new approaches to making them more capable, reliable, and adaptive.

papers.title_en: BOLT: Multi-Bottleneck Bound-Guided Learning for Flexible Job-Shop Scheduling with Time Lags and Resource-Coupled Transport
papers.authors: Ziheng Zhang, Wei Zhang, Yunyi Zhao, Zuming Liu, Wei Zhou, Boon Ping Gan
papers.evidence: 带资源耦合运输的柔性作业车间调度优化
papers.tldr: 柔性作业车间在车辆稀缺、运输等待受排程影响时形成资源耦合调度难题。BOLT 利用链、机器容量与车队容量松弛构造下界，并将每步下界增量作为奖励引导策略学习。在预制建筑实例中，显式运输耦合在重载移动占比高时优于惩罚策略；80模块三车批次平均完工时间比最佳调度规则对低13.0%，比约束规划求解器低4.2%。方法还能给出可证明的次优间隙，单核每事件决策仅2.3–5.9 ms。
papers.abstract_en: Flexible job-shop scheduling becomes resource-coupled when a scarce vehicle fleet moves jobs between stations, because the schedule sets the transport waits. BOLT (bound-oriented learning for transport-coupled scheduling) builds a lower bound from chain, machine-capacity, and fleet-capacity relaxations. The bound equals the makespan at termination, so its per-step changes form a reward that sums to a constant minus the makespan. Because it never exceeds the attainable makespan, each candidate's bound increase is a proven rise of the makespan floor, which the policy reads as a price. The root bound certifies a completed schedule's suboptimality gap without a solver. On industry-motivated 10-module prefabricated-construction instances, explicit transport coupling outperforms a transport-penalty policy in every tested cell where loaded moves occupy at least 66% of fleet time and in none at or below 56%. Across five zero-shot 50- and 80-module production batches, BOLT outperforms the best dispatching-rule pair on four and the penalty policy on the three with long moves. In the three-vehicle 80-module batch, its mean makespan is 13.0% below the best pair and 4.2% below an hour-budget constraint-programming solver whose proven gap averages 34%. BOLT decides in 2.3-5.9 ms per event on one processor core and re-plans a disruption in seconds.

papers.title_en: Has GPT-6-Astra Achieved Embodied Intelligence?
papers.authors: SenseNova, Joint Research Team, Zhongang Cai, Ziang Cao, Tailai Chen, Han Chong Chua, Linjun Dai, Hanming Deng, Hokin Deng, Haiwen Diao, Chenjing Ding, Weichen Fan, Xiao Fu, Zerui Gong, Chenyang Gu, Zexin He, Zhi Hou, Bo Li, Qinyue Li, Quanzhou Li, Xiaowan Li, Zhichao Liao, Dahua Lin, Zilong Lin, Bo Liu, Chunxiao Liu, Pengfei Liu, Tianqi Liu, Ziwei Liu, Chen Change Loy, Lewei Lu, Jiapeng Luo, Yuexiao Ma, Liang Pan, Xingang Pan, Oscar Qian, Ziyi Shang, Yuyao Shao, Dawei Su, Dacheng Tao, Qingyi Tao, Quan Wang, Ruisi Wang, Xiaogang Wang, Ziyi Wang, Beichen Wen, Donghao Wu, Jiaxu Wu, Silei Wu, Xiaoming Wu, Zhonghua Wu, Hongcan Xiao, Weiye Xu, Atsushi Yamashita, Lei Yang, Zhe Yang, Baiqiao Yin, Wanqi Yin, Hanfei Zhao, Tianbo Zhong, Long Zhuo, Jing Zuo
papers.evidence: 跨12个基准对具身操作与导航能力的大规模评测
papers.tldr: 针对通用大模型能否胜任具身智能这一问题，作者系统评估GPT-6-Astra在12个代表性基准上的表现，并考察其与低层控制器的闭环协作及8种真实机器人部署。统一协议下模型借助上下文学习取得前所未有的成功率，但真实场景仍受示范采集昂贵、执行时间与物理约束制约。作者据此提出新一代具身基准原型，并判断该模型已跨过具身能力门槛，却尚未达到实用具身智能。
papers.abstract_en: GPT-6-Astra demonstrates a level of competence in robotic manipulation and navigation that challenges the conventional paradigm of building specialized models for individual tasks and embodiments. In this report, we ask not only how capable GPT-6-Astra is, but what its capabilities imply for the field. First, we probe the limits of standalone GPT-6-Astra. We conduct a large-scale evaluation across 12 representative benchmarks spanning tabletop manipulation, humanoids, mobile platforms, and dexterous hands. Under a unified protocol that allows in-context learning (ICL) from training-set demonstrations and substantially increases the number of execution steps, GPT-6-Astra achieves unprecedented performance (Fig. 1). Future research may focus on improving 1) the generality of ICL 2) cost and execution time, 3) physical-state verification, 4) recovery from irreversible failures, and 5) long-horizon preservation of progress. Second, we study the agentic harness for embodied control. We identify that close-loop coordination between a high-level "System 2" reasoner (i.e., GPT-6-Astra) and a low-level "System 1" controller (e.g., π0.5) is costly but effective. Third, we examine GPT-6-Astra on real-world deployment. Our experiments on 8 robot configurations reveal substantial gaps: 1) robot demonstrations required for ICL are expensive to collect, and 2) it is implausible to trade longer execution for higher success rates with physical constraints. Fourth, we envision the next generation of embodied benchmarks. We develop a prototype that 1) derives tasks from real-world needs, 2) provides no in-domain demonstrations, and 3) judges agents on a world clock that keeps running while they deliberate. Taken together, our results suggest that GPT-6-Astra has largely crossed the threshold of embodied competence, but not yet that of practical embodied intelligence.

papers.title_en: Scaling Online Exploration for Robot Agents
papers.authors: Runhan Huang, Xiangcheng Zhang, Haoyu Chen, Yitong Li, Yen-Jen Wang, Bohan Lyu, Haotian Ye, Chuye Hong, Yixuan Wang, Chloe Su, Haoyu Xiong, Yangzhen Wu, Enze Xie, Travis Manderson, Stefano Ermon, Pieter Abbeel, Antonio Torralba, Dawn Song, Weirui Ye, Yilun Du
papers.evidence: 通过在线探索与代码合成实现机器人智能体学习
papers.tldr: 机器人学习依赖示教数据，新本体或任务常需专门遥操作语料，策略受模仿分布限制。RAX 让通用编码智能体通过在线探索生成机器人控制代码，并把成功决策序列编译成模块化感知—规划—控制程序。在多本体仿真与真机任务中，探索规模扩大带来持续泛化提升，仿真平均超过强基线37.4%。该开源框架无需动作示教、手工原语或价值函数，支持通过API接入新本体并展现主动感知、纠错与安全护栏等能力。
papers.abstract_en: Robot learning has advanced by scaling demonstration datasets and model capacity; however, deploying a new robot embodiment or task typically necessitates a dedicated teleoperation corpus. The resulting policies remain bounded by their imitation distributions, limiting generalization and continual self-improvement. We introduce RAX (Robot Agent eXploration), an open-source framework for robot agents centered on scaling exploration: enabling agents to improve by acquiring online experience and synthesizing executable programs. In RAX, a general-purpose coding agent generates robot control code, operating without action demonstration data, hand-engineered action primitives, or value-function guidance. Through online exploration, the agent identifies decision sequences that achieve task goals and compiles them into modular programs encapsulating the full perception-planning-control loop. Using RAX, we present a systematic multi-embodiment study on scaling online exploration across precision and long-horizon manipulation tasks using single-arm, bimanual, dexterous, mobile, and humanoid systems in simulation and on real robots. Generalization performance on unseen environments improves consistently as exploration scales. In simulation, RAX outperforms top baseline models by +37.4% on average. On real robots, RAX autonomously learns memory-dependent, articulated, high-precision, deformable, and long-horizon mobile manipulation tasks without human demonstrations, continually improving performance by composing verified skills from prior exploration sessions. As exploration scales, we observe emergent capabilities including active perception, error recovery, safety guardrails, and human-robot collaboration. We open-source RAX as a generalist robot-agent platform in which new robot embodiments are integrated through their APIs alone, without teleoperated data collection or policy training.

papers.title_en: Unifying Embodied Foundation Models via a Model-to-Policy Formulation
papers.authors: Xinyi Hong, Mingyang Ren
papers.evidence: 统一视觉语言动作模型与世界动作模型的机器人学习框架
papers.tldr: VLA模型与世界动作模型在机器人学习中各有架构与学习目标，却缺乏统一描述。本文提出基于随机核的架构无关概率框架，用条件输出分布和动作实现核刻画具身基础模型，并连接预训练、后训练与策略部署。该框架可实例化OpenVLA与DreamZero，覆盖自回归动作令牌预测和联合视频-动作生成，为统一分析与设计具身基础模型提供形式化基础。
papers.abstract_en: Vision-language-action (VLA) models and world-action models (WAMs) have emerged as promising approaches to robot learning and control. These models integrate multimodal perception and action generation, but differ in their architectures, output representations, and learning objectives. In this paper, we present a unified, architecture-agnostic probabilistic formulation for embodied foundation models based on stochastic kernels. Our formulation has two key components: (i) we characterize embodied foundation models through conditional output distributions and action-realization kernels, which together induce task-conditioned robot policies; and (ii) we connect pretraining and post-training to policy deployment, accommodating model-specific pretraining objectives and offline or online post-training strategies. We instantiate the formulation for OpenVLA and DreamZero, covering autoregressive action-token prediction and joint video-action generation.

papers.title_en: EmbodiedWorld-200K: Toward Embodied World Agents via Embodied-Planning Dataset and Interactive World Models
papers.authors: X. Feng, J. Tang, Z. Lin, L. Chen, S. Shao, Q. Lu, K. Huang
papers.evidence: 可感知、推理与行动的具身世界智能体，配套规划数据集与交互式世界模型
papers.tldr: 现有具身智能体多局限于单一场景和特定任务，难以迁移到开放世界。为此，作者发布EmbodiedWorld-200K，包含逾20万样本、多层级标注与统一评测划分，用于离线预训练。并提出以视频世界模型作为低成本环境代理，在其中进行交互式强化学习后训练。实验表明，预训练显著提升开放世界具身规划能力，世界模型内RL后训练还能改善分布外场景表现，为通用具身世界智能体研究提供数据、基线、代码与训练评测框架。
papers.abstract_en: Building embodied agents that can perceive, reason, and act across diverse 3D worlds is a central research direction toward artificial general intelligence. Yet most existing work remains confined to specific tasks in a single scene and transfers poorly to new environments, leaving general embodied agents for open-world settings under-explored. We refer to such agents as Embodied World Agents (EWAs), whose defining property is the ability to understand diverse visual environments and execute general actions in open-world conditions. To advance EWA research, we study open-world embodied navigation-planning and release EmbodiedWorld-200K, a large-scale dataset of over 200K samples spanning diverse scenes. Each example is equipped with multi-level annotations, ranging from low-level camera-motion trajectories to high-level semantic instructions. The dataset also provides unified evaluation splits and task-specific metrics, supporting offline pretraining and fair evaluation of EWAs. Beyond offline supervision, a defining characteristic of an EWA is its interaction with the environment; training solely on offline data is therefore insufficient, especially for generalizing to scenes not covered in the training distribution. Building dedicated real interactive environments, however, is often prohibitively expensive. To address this, we propose a novel training scheme that employs a video world model as a low-cost environment proxy and performs interactive reinforcement-learning (RL) post-training of the EWA within it. Empirically, pretraining on EmbodiedWorld-200K substantially improves the open-world embodied planning ability of the EWA, and further RL post-training inside a world model yields clear gains on out-of-distribution scenes. The dataset, baseline checkpoints, and training and evaluation code are available at https://xiaokunfeng.github.io/EmbodiedWorld-200K/.

papers.title_en: CoRS: Fast Neural Flexible Job-Shop Scheduling via Composite Interval State Reuse
papers.authors: Jiang Sutong, Zhao Peng, Wu Xuan, Wang Yan, Wang Jiaqi, Zhang Rui, Jiang Yuan, Zhou You, Wang Di
papers.evidence: 基于区间状态复用的柔性作业车间调度神经求解器
papers.tldr: 神经求解FJSP通常每步都刷新图表示，代价高，但每步只需保持可行性精确。CoRS将图表示与可行性状态解耦：复用区间级图表示，逐步更新可行性，并用复合区间解码、动态约束跟踪和边界同步维持可行构造。实验表明其在合成与多个公开基准上显著降低推理时间，同时保持有竞争力的解质量。该工作为紧时限和低延迟调度提供了有效的速度—质量折中。
papers.abstract_en: Neural solvers for the Flexible Job-Shop Scheduling Problem (FJSP) typically refresh graph representations and update feasibility after every operation--machine decision. However, only feasibility must remain exact at every step, whereas graph encoding is substantially more expensive and can potentially be refreshed less frequently. We present CoRS, which decouples them: an interval-level graph representation is reused across multiple sequential decisions, while a stepwise feasibility state is updated after every action. This two-timescale design amortizes graph encoding without parallelizing action generation or relaxing scheduling constraints. CoRS further develops a feasibility-preserving composite-interval decoding scheme with dynamic constraint tracking and boundary state synchronization, which reduces representation refresh frequency while maintaining continuous feasible schedule construction. Furthermore, to alleviate representation staleness caused by interval-level state reuse, CoRS introduces enhanced static features as a compensation mechanism. By providing more comprehensive structural information of the scheduling problem, these features improve the model's perception of overall problem characteristics. Extensive experiments on synthetic and multiple public FJSP benchmarks demonstrate that CoRS significantly reduces inference time while maintaining competitive solution quality, achieving favorable speed-quality trade-offs under tight wall-clock budgets and low-latency scenarios.

papers.title_en: Physical AI: Concepts, Techniques, and Challenges
papers.authors: Weinan Zhang, Chunhua Shen, Tianfan Xue, Bin Zhao, Bingqi Jiang, Zihan Guo, Zicai Cui, Yang Li, Ming Zhou, Xinyuan Chen, Lihe Ding, Xiao Chen, Yujin Wang, Shi Guo, Junting Dong, Tao Lu, Xing Shen, Haoyu Guo, Yao Mu, Haiyong Yu, Haoxiang Ma, Fuxian Huang, Qiaojun Yu, Yunsong Zhou, Kailin Li, Zirui Wang, Yufei Xue, Weishuai Zeng, Tao Huang, Zhigang Wang, Junli Liu, Pengyuan Wu, Pingrui Zhang, Haotian Wang, Dongzhan Zhou, Jiafei Cao, Feng Yuan, Xinyi Ye, Quanli Xuan, Mulin Yu, Shangding Gu, Kaiwen Song, Dong Wang, Jiarui Li, Kehui Liu, Zhongjie Jia, Dongjiang Li, Jiacheng Bao, Haoran Yang, Zhaoqing Chen, Yiming Sun, Bowen Zhou
papers.evidence: 将物理AI界定为在真实约束下感知、建模并作用于物理世界的人工系统
papers.tldr: 物理AI发展迅速，但其定义、技术版图与核心挑战仍缺共识。该专著将其界定为在真实约束下通过持续反馈感知、建模并作用于物理世界的人工系统，并厘清与数字AI、具身AI、信息物理系统及数字孪生的区别。书中建立物理、控制、认知、学习与推理基础，综述多模态感知、世界模型、具身基础模型、运动控制、多智能体与软硬件协同等方法。最后梳理机器人、制造等应用，并讨论仿真到现实、可靠性、实时性、安全治理与长期部署等挑战，指向可泛化的物理AGI。
papers.abstract_en: In recent years, physical artificial intelligence (physical AI) has experienced rapid development, capturing significant attention in academia and industry. However, the field has yet to reach consensus on its definition, technical landscape, and core challenges. To address this gap, this monograph seeks to define physical AI, present its technical landscape, and examine each key technical subfield in depth. In doing so, it establishes a unified framework for Physical AI: artificial systems that perceive, model, and act upon the physical world through continuous feedback under real-world constraints. Further, this monograph distinguishes physical AI from conventional digital AI, embodied AI, cyber-physical systems, and digital twins. It develops the foundations of physical AI across physics, control, cognition, learning, and reasoning. It reviews key methodologies, including multimodal perception, physical data and simulation, world models, embodied foundation models, motor-control systems, multi-agent coordination, and hardware-software co-design. Furthermore, it examines applications spanning robotics, manufacturing, infrastructure, scientific experimentation, and autonomous services. Particular attention is given to sim-to-real transfer, reliability, real-time execution, evaluation, safety, governance, and long-term deployment. By connecting perception, prediction, decision-making, action, and adaptation in a closed loop, this monograph identifies the technical challenges and research directions required to advance from narrow automation toward more generalizable physical AI and, ultimately, physical artificial general intelligence (Physical AGI).

papers.title_en: TARSphere: A Robot-Oriented Full-Stack Framework for Long-Horizon Embodied Agents in Evolving Physical and Social Environments
papers.authors: Yicheng Xu, Zhikai Xu, Ziyuan Chen, Yuhang Dong, Tao Zhang, Zhucun Xue, Yong Liu, Jiangning Zhang
papers.evidence: 面向物理与社会环境的长时程具身智能体全栈框架
papers.tldr: 现有具身智能体多面向指定目标或符号化执行，难以在物理与社会约束并存、环境持续变化的场景中评估。TARSphere构建机器人导向全栈框架：物理仿真基础设施含具身NPC与受限对话，事件驱动FSM更新任务状态，冻结MLLM通过多级可执行技能、层次记忆与执行反馈决策。基于此构建覆盖30个室内场景的360个episode、五类配对条件基准。评测8个MLLM发现通用模型可优于具身模型，但任务更新与人机协作仍难，碰撞跌倒凸显执行安全需与成功率并评。
papers.abstract_en: Robots must act under physical and social constraints while adapting to changes in their environment and human needs. Existing embodied-agent systems often focus on specified goals or abstract execution into symbolic actions, limiting evaluation in an evolving world. We introduce TARSphere, a robot-oriented full-stack framework for physically and socially grounded long-horizon embodied agents. TARSphere-Infra runs robot policies in a physics simulator with embodied NPCs and constrained dialogue. An event-driven finite-state machine (FSM) uses completed actions and delivered information to update task states and evaluate outcomes. TARSphere-Harness, its embodied brain harness, lets a frozen multimodal large language model (MLLM) act through multi-level executable skills, using observations, hierarchical memory, and execution feedback to revise its decisions. On this foundation, agent-in-the-loop curation aligns task semantics, causal dependencies, and scene geometry to construct TARSphere-Bench: 360 episodes across 30 indoor scenes. Five paired conditions assess perceptual robustness, disruption adaptation, task update, human coordination, and intent understanding for navigate-and-report and fetch-and-deliver tasks. Our evaluation of 8 MLLMs shows that general-purpose models can outperform embodied models, while task updates and human interaction remain difficult. Frequent collisions and falls further motivate evaluating execution safety alongside task success, even with a shared action interface and decision budget.

papers.title_en: Multimodal Embodied Agents: A Unified Capability-centric Perspective from Computer-Use to Robot-Use
papers.authors: Yanzhe Chen, Ziyi Yang, Jifeng Zhu, Qiming Huang, Ruihe An, Peiyao Xu, Hesen Yang, Runda Liu, Chang Gong, Zhijun Cao, Zechen Bai, Wenzheng Zeng, Yiqi Lin, Guoqiang Liang, Kevin Yuchen Ma, Kevin Qinghong Lin, Mike Zheng Shou
papers.evidence: 具身智能体感知、预期、规划、执行与验证的能力框架
papers.tldr: 多模态智能体正从计算机使用走向机器人使用，物理动态、部分可观测和难以回退等约束显著改变任务决策方式。作者提出PAPAV能力中心框架，将感知、预期、规划、执行、验证五类功能统一起来，比较MMEA、MMA与机器人系统。基于64个基准的梳理发现，评估几乎集中于执行，仅5个涉及预期、3个涉及验证。该框架为设计可靠物理智能体、按五类能力而非单一任务成功率衡量进展提供共同基础。
papers.abstract_en: Multimodal agents (MMAs) sustain interaction through reasoning, memory, tools, and feedback, most visibly as computer-use agents, while robotic systems (RSs) couple sensing and actuation under physical dynamics. We define multimodal embodied agents (MMEAs) as goal-directed systems that couple multimodal task reasoning with physical action and revise decisions from the resulting feedback. This raises a central question: what changes when a multimodal agent moves from computer-use to robot-use? We introduce PAPAV, a unified capability-centric framework of five recurring functions: Perceive the current state, Anticipate action effects, Plan a feasible course, Act through an interface or body, and Verify the outcome. Defined by function rather than architecture, these capabilities let PAPAV identify what all three share and then compare MMEAs with MMAs and with RSs. Five physical constraints, from partial observability to unverifiable outcomes, leave fewer choices fixed in advance and less room to reverse errors. Across 64 benchmarks, explicit evaluation centers on Act; only 5 assess Anticipate and 3 assess Verify, leaving both largely hidden behind task success. These constraints also frame the open challenges we identify. PAPAV therefore provides a common basis for designing reliable physical agents and measuring progress across all five capabilities rather than task success alone.

papers.title_en: EmbodiedSWE: Coding Agents for Long Horizon Dexterous Robotics
papers.authors: Zeyu Shen, Haoxiang You, Yilang Liu, Zhicheng Zheng, Lihan Zha, Kashu Yamazaki, Mingtong Zhang, Suning Huang, Jiankai Sun, Qianzhong Chen, Lucy He, Kaiyuan Liu, Haoran Chang, Katerina Fragkiadaki, Dhruv Shah, Mac Schwager, Peter Henderson, Ian Abraham, Canwen Xu
papers.evidence: 用编码智能体解决长时程灵巧机器人任务并提供可扩展监督
papers.tldr: 研究面向长时程灵巧机器人的编码智能体，检验其解能否为通用机器人策略提供可扩展监督。作者构建 EMBODIEDSWE-BENCH 仿真基准，覆盖富接触操作、可变形物体和需半小时连续交互的任务。前沿编码智能体可求解复杂任务并跨任务/本体迁移，但解依赖迭代交互且多偏任务实例专用。为此提出 EMBODIEDSWE-GEN，将单个解扩展为多样轨迹训练 VLA；更多演示提升性能，智能体辅助多样化改善泛化，仅用仿真演示微调的 VLA 可在真实机器人完成长时程任务。
papers.abstract_en: We study coding agents for long-horizon, dexterous robotics and ask whether their solutions can provide scalable supervision for learning general robot policies. To test this, we develop EMBODIEDSWE-BENCH, a simulation benchmark for coding agents spanning contact-rich manipulation, deformable objects, and long-horizon tasks requiring up to half an hour of continuous interaction. We find that frontier coding agents can solve complex long-horizon tasks and transfer prior solutions across both tasks and embodiments. We also design supporting tools that help agents more effectively solve these tasks. However, the resulting solutions require substantial iterative interaction and are typically specialized to individual task instances. We therefore introduce EMBODIEDSWE-GEN, which expands a single solution from coding agent into large diverse trajectories for training a VLA. VLA performance improves with more generated demonstrations, and agent-aided diversification improves generalization to held-out task variations. We also show that a VLA finetuned solely on coding-agent-generated simulation demonstrations completes a long-horizon task on real robot. Together, our framework uses coding agents to solve complex robotics tasks and turn verified solutions into scalable supervision for robot policies.

papers.title_en: Curriculum Learning with GNN-based Reinforcement Learning for Job Shop Scheduling
papers.authors: Jayakrishnan K. Vasudevan, Jonathan Hoss, Noah Klarmann
papers.evidence: 面向作业车间调度的图神经网络强化学习课程学习
papers.tldr: 针对作业车间调度中GNN强化学习训练大实例昂贵、跨规模泛化难的问题，本文研究课程学习策略，先在较小实例上训练策略，再逐步适配20×20、25×25和30×30目标规模，并与单一规模训练对比。在8×8至30×30未见实例上以最优性间隙评估。结果显示课程学习持续缩短实际训练时间，且目标规模越大收益越明显；30×30时全评估规模平均间隙降低约8.1个百分点、目标规模降低约8.6个百分点，并节省约50小时训练。
papers.abstract_en: The job shop scheduling problem is a challenging combinatorial optimization problem, and recent reinforcement learning approaches using graph neural networks have shown promise for learning scheduling policies directly from problem instances. However, training on large instances remains computationally expensive, and generalization across instance sizes remains challenging. This paper studies curriculum learning for graph neural network-based reinforcement learning in the job shop scheduling problem by comparing it with single-size training across three target sizes: 20 x 20, 25 x 25, and 30 x 30. In the curriculum setting, the policy is first trained on smaller instances and then progressively adapted to larger target sizes, allowing scheduling behavior learned in earlier stages to support learning on larger instances. Models are evaluated on unseen instances from 8 x 8 to 30 x 30 using the optimality gap, considering both generalization across all evaluation sizes and specialization on the target size. Results show that curriculum learning consistently reduces wall-clock training time, with larger benefits as the target size increases. The strongest advantage is observed at 30 x 30, where curriculum learning reduces the mean optimality gap across all evaluation sizes by approximately 8.1 percentage points, reduces the target-size mean optimality gap by approximately 8.6 percentage points, and saves approximately 50 hours of training time.

papers.title_en: Strong NP-Hardness and Approximation Algorithm for Weighted Tardiness with Release Dates and Identical Processing Times
papers.authors: Zhi-Long Chen, Nicholas G. Hall
papers.evidence: 单机加权拖期调度的复杂度与近似算法
papers.tldr: 研究单机、释放期、工期与相同加工时间下最小化总加权拖期的问题，其复杂度自2010年以来悬而未决。作者由无权MAX-CUT归约，证明判定版本强NP完全，并构造归一化定理把低成本可行调度转化为每个顶点的二选一。进一步提出确定性多项式时间相位网格分配算法，枚举释放期模p的余数并求解最小费用分配。该算法在平移目标上达到紧比3/2-1/(2N)，既解决长期复杂度问题，也给出最坏情形近似保证。
papers.abstract_en: We study nonpreemptive scheduling on a single machine with release dates, due dates, positive job weights, and a common processing time. The objective is to minimize total weighted tardiness. Although closely related equal-processing-time problems admit polynomial-time algorithms, the complexity of this problem has remained open in the literature since 2010. We prove that its decision version is strongly NP-complete, even when every job can meet its due date if processed immediately upon release. The reduction is from unweighted MAX-CUT and uses a quadratic number of jobs with polynomially bounded numerical data. Its main ingredient is a constructive normalization theorem that converts every sufficiently inexpensive feasible schedule into a binary choice for each graph vertex; after normalization, total weighted tardiness equals a constant minus a scaled cut value. We also give a deterministic polynomial-time phase-grid assignment algorithm for the shifted objective $Φ=F+p\sum_jw_j$, where $F$ is total weighted tardiness. The algorithm enumerates at most $N$ release-date residues modulo $p$, solves one minimum-cost assignment problem for each residue, and returns the best phase-grid schedule. It runs in $O(N^5)$ arithmetic operations and achieves the tight ratio $3/2-1/(2N)$ for this algorithm. Because the added term $p\sum_jw_j$ is independent of how the jobs are scheduled, the shifted and original objectives have exactly the same optimal schedules. However, the approximation guarantee applies to the shifted objective; for the original objective, the analysis provides an additive bound. Thus, the paper both resolves the long-standing complexity question and provides a complementary worst-case guarantee for the phase-grid assignment algorithm.

papers.title_en: Dynamic Task and Resource Scheduling Towards Space-Air-Ground-Sea Integrated Network
papers.authors: Yufei Ye, Shijian Gao, Xinhu Zheng, Liuqing Yang
papers.evidence: 跨卫星、高空平台、基站与无人机的动态任务与资源调度
papers.tldr: 面向6G泛在连接下的空天地海一体化网络，海上基础设施稀缺且业务移动性强，任务与资源调度面临四层协同难题。论文提出动态任务卸载算法，结合卫星切换预判、UAV剩余能量约束，并联合优化UAV-BS带宽、轨迹与计算资源。仿真显示复杂海域中平均任务时延至少降低23%，验证了对系统资源变化的适应性。该工作为海事计算服务提供跨层动态调度方案。
papers.abstract_en: In the context of 6G ubiquitous connectivity, the space-air-ground-sea integrated network (SAGSIN) emerges as a new paradigm for pervasive service provisioning. To support expanding maritime activities in infrastructure-scarce ocean areas, we propose an innovative dynamic task and resource scheduling approach for SAGSIN to deliver computing services for vessels. It integrates broad-coverage satellites, relay-capable high-altitude platform (HAP), energy-sufficient coastal base station (BS), and flexibly deployed uncrewed aerial vehicles (UAVs) to accommodate wide-area, highly mobile, and sustained maritime services. To address the challenge of task scheduling across four layers, a dynamic task offloading algorithm is developed. It steers task flows toward servers with light loads, strong computing capabilities, and high-rate links based on real-time system states to reduce task execution delay, integrating an anticipatory satellite handover strategy to mitigate post-handover congestion and improving satellite resource utilization. Considering the limited endurance of UAVs, we impose residual energy constraints to ensure task backlog handover and safe return. Furthermore, the UAV-BS bandwidth allocation, UAV trajectories, and computing resource allocation are jointly optimized to enhance the connectivity among low-altitude devices and accelerate task completion. Simulation results validate the proposed method's superior adaptability to system resource variations during task execution in complex maritime environments, achieving at least a 23% reduction in average task delay over benchmarks.

papers.title_en: Gaps and Augmentations in Bayesian Scheduling
papers.authors: Ahuva Mu'alem
papers.evidence: 贝叶斯激励相容调度机制的近似界
papers.tldr: 在无关机调度中，Nisan-Ronen 猜想解决后，确定性 truthful 机制的最坏近似比恰为 m。本文考察先验信息、贝叶斯激励相容、随机化以及机器侧资源增强能否突破这一障碍。作者证明两机随机 BIC 机制存在渐近 4/3 下界，无先验两机随机化可改进至 7/4，并给出 8/7 的 BIC 整数性间隙；当任务分配充分分散时，O(m/ε) 采样层足以让 MinWork 达到 1+ε 近似。这些结果说明随机化在先验依赖的 BIC 调度中可严格必要，并从资源增强视角给出新的理论调度保证。
papers.abstract_en: The recent resolution of the Nisan--Ronen conjecture~\cite{NR,CKK} establishes that the optimal worst-case approximation ratio of deterministic truthful mechanisms for makespan on m unrelated machines is exactly m. We ask how prior information, Bayesian incentive compatibility (BIC), randomization, and machine-side resource augmentation change this barrier.   We obtain three main results. First, we prove an asymptotic 4/3 lower bound for randomized BIC mechanisms with two machines, strengthening the previous 1.2 deterministic-BIC lower bound~\cite{MS}.
